patterns: Direct one-liners dominate: Siladitya title, Bana patronised by Harsha, Harsha authored Nagananda, Hiuen Tsang visited under Harsha.
Recurring trap: 'Which work is NOT by Harsha' - Harshacharita/Kadambari (Bana) vs Ratnavali/Priyadarshika/Nagananda.
Capital shift Thanesar -> Kannauj and Kannauj as Maukhari capital are asked repeatedly; Kannauj and Prayag assemblies as a pair.
Vakatakas appear as statement sets on Vindhyashakti (founder) vs Pravarasena I (four Ashvamedhas, Samrat).
App MCQs lean on long statement/match sets and Andhra details from Hiuen Tsang; PYQs are shorter, author-work and ruler-title matching.
